title: diag.5: radio — RF path asymmetry detector
description: Track TX-success count vs RX-ever count over 60s windows. If TX > 10 and RX == 0, report DIAG_RADIO_TX_ONLY (RF switch stuck or missing RX path). If RX > 10 and every TX returns error, report DIAG_RADIO_RX_ONLY. Detects RF switch misconfiguration.
close_reason: RF path asymmetry detector landed (diag.5, spec 02a 2a.10.5 family): lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/rf_path_asymmetry.c + include/lichen/rf_path_asymmetry.h — freestanding tumbling 60-second window tracking tx_ok/tx_err/rx_frames; evaluate() returns TX_ONLY (tx_ok > 10 and zero RX frames — RF switch stuck in TX path), RX_ONLY (rx > 10 and tx_ok == 0 and tx_err > 0 — every attempted TX errored), or NONE, then tumbles the window. Verification: standalone behavioral harness — TX_ONLY (15 ok TX/0 RX), RX_ONLY (1 failed TX attempt + 15 RX), quiet-node false-positive guard (15 RX, no TX attempts -> NONE, per review finding 4), below-threshold NONE, both-healthy NONE, tumbling reset, never-active guard — all pass under -Wall -Wextra -Werror. CMake updated. Codereview rounds (Kimi K3): full pass timed out; narrow pass found 4 findings — (1) threshold 10-vs-11 naming nit documented (comment now says strictly-greater), (2) window_start==0 sentinel collision with a legitimate now_ms==0 first event — fixed with an explicit bool active flag, (3) tumbling reset PASS, (4) RX_ONLY false positive on zero TX attempts — fixed by requiring tx_err > 0 (gives the previously-unused tx_err counter a purpose); both fixes verified by updated harness cases (quiet-node -> NONE). cppcheck gate exit 0.
